title: MI60041: Risk And Reliability Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to reliability concepts, Unit and system reliability â forward
models, Density and distribution functions, Fault tree analysis, HAZOP
analysis, Risk and criticality analysis, maintainability analysis, Calculations
of maintainability parameters, Availability calculations, and maintenance
management. Introduction to product quality, Statistical quality control,
Introduction to ISO 9000 series, TQM and CI.
